app.editor.motion.regionHelp: Select the textured region in the source’s first frame. Tracking can lose the region during occlusion or rapid movement.
app.editor.motion.policy: Creates a separate local MP4, preserving AAC audio exactly. Use an AAC or silent video. Up to 30 seconds at 720p; optical flow up to 10 seconds at 480p/60 fps. Stabilization crops edges; optical flow may distort fast motion. The source stays editable.
app.editor.transcript.help: Edit the video by selecting timed words. A range cut removes that interval from every track and closes its gap; Undo restores the edit. Review recognition and timings first.
app.editor.transcript.selectHelp: Select a word to seek. Shift-click another word to extend the range, or use the range selectors below. Captions without word timing can be selected only as whole cues; estimated words cannot define a source cut.
app.editor.transcript.correctHelp: Press Enter or leave the field to save. Correction keeps this word’s measured time. It changes caption text, without cutting audio.
app.editor.pack.manifestLimit: Choose an asset pack under 128 KiB.
app.editor.pack.filesLimit: Choose up to 40 files totalling 256 MiB.
app.editor.pack.help: Browse your own or licensed files with a catalog manifest. Packs can describe media and credits; they cannot run code or connect to accounts. Files stay on this device until you use a separate upload action.
app.editor.pack.confirm: I have the rights to use the files in this edit. The catalog records my supplied terms.
app.chat.media.sourceHelp: Follows your uploaded source at the displayed price
app.chat.media.refundHelp: . Failed jobs return their Credits; finished media is saved to Library
app.chat.workspace.researchHelp: Plans a few searches, reads what the web returns, then writes a cited answer. It can take up to about a minute and works on text only. If it fails before the answer starts, the Credits come back.
app.chat.settings.filterHelp: Show only models at these prices per reply. Pick none to see them all.
app.chat.settings.thinkingHelp: Let the model reason step by step before it answers. Slower, and better on hard questions.
app.chat.settings.imagesHelp: Attach pictures with the paperclip (or a few frames from a video), or pick one you already made with From library. The extra applies only to replies that include images.
app.chat.settings.webHelp: Search the web and answer with sources.
app.chat.settings.researchHelp: Plans a few searches, reads what the web returns, then writes a cited answer. Text only, and it can take up to about a minute.
app.chat.settings.priceHelp: The price is fixed per reply. It shows before you send, and a failed reply returns the Credits.
app.editor.sheet.audioHelp: The audio is cut to the video’s length.
app.editor.sheet.slowHelp: Slow motion can take several minutes to finish, longer for taller or larger videos. If it fails, your credits are refunded.
app.editor.sheet.captionHelp: Captions are written from the speech in the finished video. A video with no speech can’t be captioned: the edit fails and your credits are refunded.
app.create.character.intro: Explore body shapes, sculptural hair, imaginative costumes and fantasy characters. Build a distinctive personality, visual style and recurring show.
app.create.character.remixHelp: Remix one changes a styling trait. Choose body shape and arm, leg, hand and foot sizes yourself in Body.
app.create.character.policy: The prompt always describes an original adult fictional character, never a real person. Save the strongest result to your Library and reuse it as a visual reference for consistency.
app.publish.autolists.intro: Turn RSS or Atom feed items into queue-ready posts without copying feed HTML or media.
app.publish.autolists.roleHelp: Your team role can view Autolists but cannot change them.
app.publish.autolists.scheduleHelp: New unique items become text-only posts in the next open slots for this queue. Feed HTML and media are never copied. Turn this off to review imported items first.
app.publish.autolists.refreshHelp: Feeds refresh on the five-minute worker cycle. Items are deduplicated by their feed ID or canonical link.
app.publish.commerce.intro: Build a product catalogue with variants, inventory, collections and discounts for social campaigns.
app.publish.commerce.syncHelp: Product records are ready for campaigns. Shopify and WooCommerce sync stays disabled until provider connections and sync controls are added.
app.publish.commerce.archiveHelp: This hides the product from the active catalogue. Existing campaign drafts are unchanged.
app.publish.commerce.variantsHelp: Add sizes, colours or other purchasable versions when needed.
app.enhance.intro: Choose a short clip, adjust the look, and download a copy. Your video stays in this browser. This experimental preview uses no credits.
app.enhance.requirements: Start with a single-person clip. MP4, WebM or MOV, up to 100 MiB and a longest edge of 1920 pixels.
app.enhance.smoothingHelp: Start low to retain texture. Smoothing can also affect hands or hair covering the face. Turn it off for those clips, and check eyes and head turns before keeping your export.
app.enhance.previewHelp: You can still preview and adjust this clip.
app.enhance.exportHelp: Keep this tab visible during export. Export supports MP4 input with one video track and up to one AAC audio track. Subtitles and descriptive metadata are not included. Output is H.264 MP4 when this browser supports it.
app.enhance.localOnly: Video Enhance is available only in an enabled local development preview.
